result:
These are first-attempt queries written from the page alone. I could not run any of them, so some details are guesses. The main ones are whether `groupBy` accepts a string key, how `round` takes its digits (I used `mul`, `round`, `div` instead), and whether `flat` splices a vector of sets.

S1: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | count`
S2: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee) * count`
S3: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :priority | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /id`
S4: `[(/dependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) (/devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys)] | flat | distinct | sort`
S5: `* ({:customer /customer :total (/items * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum)}) | groupBy ~(/customer) | vals * ({:customer (first | /customer) :total (* /total | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)}) | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2`
S6: `/data/users | filter ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * (/email | lower) | sort`
S7: `lines | * split " " | filter ~(at 1 | coalesce "" | upper | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count`
S8: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10)`
S9: `filter ~(/published | eq true) | * (at :tags | coalesce [] | * lower | distinct | sort) | flat | groupBy ~(/) | vals * ({:tag first :count count}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /tag]) | take 3`
S10: `/services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) * (at :port)`
S11: `filter ~(at :stock | coalesce 0 | gt 0) | * (/category | lower) | distinct | sort`
S12: `"The cat and the Hat and THE bat sat on a mat with the cat" | split " " | * lower | groupBy ~(/) | vals * ({:word first :count count}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word]) | take 3`
S13: `groupBy ~(/user) | vals * ({:user (first | /user) :count count :first (* /ts | min)}) | sort ~(/user)`
S14: `lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(trim | ne "") | * split "|" | filter ~(/1 | lower | startsWith "eu-") | filter ~(/2 | ne "down") | sort ~(/3 | parseJson | desc) | * /0 | join ","`
